description: Face up, till he must sit

participation.context: Named the glass face up, and would not ask.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Laid it on the seat, and took the silence as leave to keep it.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Pointed him at the peg, and at the door for the rest.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Stood in the lords' room with his arms folded. He did not speak.
participation.name: James Burbage

relations.quote: Face up, till I must sit.

story.body: You saw where he laid it. You said nobody was asking. You did not make him explain the curtain yet.

relations.quote: Face up, till I must sit.

title: Let the glass stay face up on the throne

participation.context: Stood at the door, and did not take the plot down.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: His hand on the entrances. He is not in the picture.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

story.body: You stood where the pasteboard hangs. The picture keeps the hand, not the man.

title: Left the plot on the peg

participation.context: Read the four boxes, and did not unpeg the board.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: The hand is his. He was not beside the peg for this.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

story.body: You took the four boxes you needed. You left the smaller hand where it was.

title: Read four boxes on the plot

participation.context: Spoke the phrase round the clove, called the curtain the law, and stayed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Lost the crown behind the curtain, and kept the street.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Was exact in the lengthened gown, and did not stop for the grain.
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.context: Looked up from tuning, and down, and would not name it.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Took the only laugh, from the hired men.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Ate the apple, and said it wants a dog.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Called him clear, and left the plot on the peg.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: In the lords' room, arms folded. He did not speak.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Laughed at the gardener. They had no other line.
participation.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

relations.note: the dog, said to an apple

story.body: You gave the empty house the phrase and stayed at the door. You heard the grain and did not name it further. You left Kemp the apple and the jig, and you stayed on this bank.

relations.note: the dog, said to an apple

title: Spoke round the clove and stood the rest at the door

participation.context: Played the afternoon, and stayed on this bank.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read the title and the hour. You did not give the side a name. You read Faustus on the paper and did not cross.

title: Played Richard the Third, with Faustus over the water
